content: 1. Linezolid increases the toxicity of methadone through an unknown mechanism. This interaction may lead to serious adverse effects such as hypotension, hyperpyrexia, somnolence, or even death. It is recommended to avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is necessary, separate the administration by at least 14 days. 2. Linezolid enhances the effects of methamphetamine due to pharmacodynamic synergism. This interaction is contraindicated as it poses a risk of acute hypertensive episodes. 3. Linezolid and methylene blue both increase serotonin levels as a result of monoamine oxidase-A (MAO-A) inhibition. This combination should be avoided or an alternative drug should be used. If coadministration is unavoidable, monitor closely for central nervous system (CNS) toxicity. 4. Linezolid increases the effects of methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA) through pharmacodynamic synergism. This interaction is contraindicated due to the risk of acute hypertensive episodes. 5. Linezolid enhances the effects of methylphenidate via pharmacodynamic synergism. This interaction is contraindicated as it may lead to acute hypertensive episodes. 6. Intranasal metoclopramide increases the toxicity of linezolid through an unspecified mechanism. Metoclopramide may enhance the hypertensive effects of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs). Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug, and monitor closely if necessary. 7. Linezolid and metrizoate may interact through an unspecified mechanism, increasing the risk of seizures. Discontinue MAO inhibitors 24 hours before administering metrizoate. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Linezolid decreases the effects of oral microbiota by pharmacodynamic antagonism. Antibiotics may reduce the efficacy of bacterial spores in oral microbiota. Complete antibiotic regimens 2–4 days before initiating oral microbiota therapy. 9. Linezolid increases the effects of midodrine through pharmacodynamic synergism. This interaction is contraindicated due to the risk of acute hypertensive episodes. 10. If linezolid must be administered, discontinue serotonergic drugs immediately and monitor for CNS toxicity. Serotonergic therapy may be resumed 24 hours after the last linezolid dose or after 2 weeks of monitoring, whichever comes first. 11.
